children: Podbere Burt W., an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, reported sales of Class A common stock at weighted average prices ranging from $237.65 to $244.47 per share for total proceeds of $8,069,977 and directly owns 662,936 Class A common stock and indirectly owns 1,158,392 Class A common stock following the transactions.

Saha Anurag, an officer serving as Chief Accounting Officer, reported sales of Class A common stock on September 21, 2026 at a weighted average price of $231.62 per share for total proceeds of $1,625,902 and directly owns 205,876 Class A common shares following the transactions.

Michael Sentonas, an officer serving as President, reported sales of Class A common stock in three transactions on September 21, 2026 at weighted average prices of $231.61, $238.21 and $242.64 per share for total proceeds of $11,555,358 and directly owns 1,474,541 Class A common shares following the transactions.
